032/**
033 * A basic {@link org.apache.http.HttpEntity} implementation with additional features.
034 *
035 * Provides the following features:
036 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
037 *    <li>
038 *       Caching.
039 *    <li>
040 *       Fluent setters.
041 *    <li>
042 *       Fluent assertions.
043 *    <li>
044 *       Externally-supplied/dynamic content.
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <p>
048 * Immutability is expressed with the "funnel + nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot" paradigm: every fluent setter
049 * routes through the single protected {@link #modify(Runnable)} choke-point, and each concrete leaf gets a nested
050 * {@code X.Unmodifiable} whose only behavioral override is a throwing {@code modify(...)}.  A leaf's
051 * {@link #unmodifiable()} factory returns a point-in-time snapshot of type {@code X.Unmodifiable}; any attempt to set a
052 * property on it throws an {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.
053 *
054 * <p>
055 * This is a self-typed (CRTP) root: a leaf declares <c>class StringEntity <jk>extends</jk> BasicHttpEntity&lt;StringEntity&gt;</c>
056 * and inherits leaf-typed fluent setters with no covariant overrides.
057 *
058 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
059 *    <li class='warn'>Beans are not thread safe unless they're marked as unmodifiable.
060 * </ul>
061 *
062 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
063 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauRestCommon">juneau-rest-common Basics</a>
064 * </ul>
065 *
066 * @param <SELF> The self type for fluent setters.
067 */
068@BeanIgnore
069
070@SuppressWarnings({
071   "resource", // Content may be streams; only reference equality is used for the content field.
072   "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
073})
074public abstract class BasicHttpEntity<SELF extends BasicHttpEntity<SELF>> implements HttpEntity {
075
076   /**
077    * An empty HttpEntity.
078    */
079   @SuppressWarnings({
080      "java:S2390" // Convenience constant, not a static-init cycle: ByteArrayEntity()/unmodifiable() touch no static state of either class (only per-instance fields), so nothing here observes a not-yet-initialized value.
081   })
082   public static final BasicHttpEntity<?> EMPTY = new ByteArrayEntity().unmodifiable();
083
084   private boolean cached;
085   private boolean chunked;
086   private Object content;
087   private Supplier<?> contentSupplier;
088   private ContentType contentType;
089   private ContentEncoding contentEncoding;
090   private Charset charset;
091   private long contentLength = -1;
092   private int maxLength = -1;
093
094   /**
095    * Constructor.
096    */
097   protected BasicHttpEntity() {}
098
099   /**
100    * Copy constructor.
101    *
102    * @param copyFrom The bean being copied.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
103    */
104   protected BasicHttpEntity(BasicHttpEntity<?> copyFrom) {
105      this.cached = copyFrom.cached;
106      this.chunked = copyFrom.chunked;
107      this.content = copyFrom.content;
108      this.contentSupplier = copyFrom.contentSupplier;
109      this.contentType = copyFrom.contentType;
110      this.contentEncoding = copyFrom.contentEncoding;
111      this.contentLength = copyFrom.contentLength;
112      this.charset = copyFrom.charset;
113      this.maxLength = copyFrom.maxLength;
114   }
115
116   /**
117    * Constructor.
118    *
119    * @param contentType The entity content type.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to omit an explicit <c>Content-Type</c> header.
120    * @param content The entity content.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (the effect depends on the concrete leaf type: e.g. treated as empty for {@link StringEntity}/{@link ByteArrayEntity}, or a {@link NullPointerException} on read for {@link StreamEntity}/{@link ReaderEntity}/{@link FileEntity}).
121    */
122   protected BasicHttpEntity(ContentType contentType, Object content) {
123      this.contentType = contentType;
124      this.content = content;
125   }
126
127   /**
128    * Converts the contents of this entity as a byte array.
129    *
130    * <p>
131    * Note that this may exhaust the content on non-repeatable, non-cached entities.
132    *
133    * @return The contents of this entity as a byte array.
134    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred while trying to read the content.
135    */
136   public byte[] asBytes() throws IOException {
137      return readBytes(getContent());
138   }
139
140   /**
141    * Returns an assertion on the contents of this entity.
142    *
143    * <p>
144    * Note that this may exhaust the content on non-repeatable, non-cached entities.
145    *
146    * @return A new fluent assertion.
147    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred while trying to read the byte array.
148    */
149   public FluentByteArrayAssertion<BasicHttpEntity<?>> assertBytes() throws IOException {
150      return new FluentByteArrayAssertion<>(asBytes(), this);
151   }
152
153   /**
154    * Returns an assertion on the contents of this entity.
155    *
156    * <p>
157    * Note that this may exhaust the content on non-repeatable, non-cached entities.
158    *
159    * @return A new fluent assertion.
160    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred while trying to read the byte array.
161    */
162   public FluentStringAssertion<BasicHttpEntity<?>> assertString() throws IOException {
163      return new FluentStringAssertion<>(asString(), this);
164   }
165
166   /**
167    * Converts the contents of this entity as a string.
168    *
169    * <p>
170    * Note that this may exhaust the content on non-repeatable, non-cached entities.
171    *
172    * @return The contents of this entity as a string.
173    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred while trying to read the content.
174    */
175   public String asString() throws IOException {
176      return read(getContent());
177   }
178
179   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
180   public void consumeContent() throws IOException {
181      // No-op: Intentional empty implementation for optional interface method
182   }
183
184   /**
185    * Creates a builder for this class initialized with the contents of this bean.
186    *
187    * <p>
188    * Allows you to create a modifiable copy of this bean.
189    *
190    * @return A new builder bean.
191    */
192   public abstract SELF copy();
193
194   /**
195    * Returns the charset to use when converting to and from stream-based resources.
196    *
197    * @return The charset to use when converting to and from stream-based resources.
198    */
199   public Charset getCharset() { return charset == null ? UTF8 : charset; }
200
201   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
202   public InputStream getContent() throws IOException, UnsupportedOperationException { return EMPTY_INPUT_STREAM; }
203
204   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
205   public Header getContentEncoding() { return contentEncoding; }
206
207   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
208   public long getContentLength() { return contentLength; }
209
210   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
211   public Header getContentType() { return contentType; }
212
213   /**
214    * Returns the maximum number of bytes to read or write to and from stream-based resources.
215    *
216    * @return The maximum number of bytes to read or write to and from stream-based resources.
217    */
218   public int getMaxLength() { return maxLength; }
219
220   /**
221    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this entity is cached in-memory.
222    *
223    * @return <jk>true</jk> if this entity is cached in-memory.
224    */
225   public boolean isCached() { return cached; }
226
227   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
228   public boolean isChunked() { return chunked; }
229
230   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
231   public boolean isRepeatable() { return false; }
232
233   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
234   public boolean isStreaming() { return false; }
235
236   /**
237    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this bean is unmodifiable.
238    *
239    * @return <jk>true</jk> if this bean is an {@link UnmodifiableBean} snapshot.
240    */
241   public boolean isUnmodifiable() { return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean; }
242
243   /**
244    * Specifies that the contents of this resource should be cached into an internal byte array so that it can
245    * be read multiple times.
246    *
247    * @return This object.
248    * @throws IOException If entity could not be read into memory.
249    */
250   public SELF setCached() throws IOException {
251      return modify(() -> cached = true);
252   }
253
254   /**
255    * Specifies the charset to use when converting to and from stream-based resources.
256    *
257    * @param value The new value.  If <jk>null</jk>, <c>UTF-8</c> is assumed.
258    * @return This object.
259    */
260   public SELF setCharset(Charset value) {
261      return modify(() -> charset = value);
262   }
263
264   /**
265    * Sets the 'chunked' flag value to <jk>true</jk>.
266    *
267    * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
268    *    <li class='note'>If the {@link HttpEntity#getContentLength()} method returns a negative value, the HttpClient code will always
269    *       use chunked encoding.
270    * </ul>
271    *
272    * @return This object.
273    */
274   public SELF setChunked() {
275      return setChunked(true);
276   }
277
278   /**
279    * Sets the 'chunked' flag value.
280    *
281    * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
282    *    <li class='note'>If the {@link HttpEntity#getContentLength()} method returns a negative value, the HttpClient code will always
283    *       use chunked encoding.
284    * </ul>
285    *
286    * @param value The new value for this flag.
287    * @return This object.
288    */
289   public SELF setChunked(boolean value) {
290      return modify(() -> chunked = value);
291   }
292
293   /**
294    * Sets the content on this entity bean.
295    *
296    * @param value The entity content.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (the effect depends on the concrete leaf type: e.g. treated as empty for {@link StringEntity}/{@link ByteArrayEntity}, or a {@link NullPointerException} on read for {@link StreamEntity}/{@link ReaderEntity}/{@link FileEntity}).
297    * @return This object.
298    */
299   public SELF setContent(Object value) {
300      return modify(() -> content = value);
301   }
302
303   /**
304    * Sets the content on this entity bean from a supplier.
305    *
306    * <p>
307    * Repeatable entities such as {@link StringEntity} use this to allow the entity content to be resolved at
308    * serialization time.
309    *
310    * @param value The entity content, can be <jk>null</jk> (treated as a supplier that always returns <jk>null</jk>).
311    * @return This object.
312    */
313   public SELF setContent(Supplier<?> value) {
314      return modify(() -> contentSupplier = value == null ? () -> null : value);
315   }
316
317   /**
318    * Sets the content encoding header on this entity bean.
319    *
320    * @param value The new <c>Content-Encoding</c> header, or <jk>null</jk> to unset.
321    * @return This object.
322    */
323   public SELF setContentEncoding(ContentEncoding value) {
324      return modify(() -> contentEncoding = value);
325   }
326

328    * Sets the content encoding header on this entity bean.
329    *

331    * @return This object.
332    */
333   public SELF setContentEncoding(String value) {
334      return setContentEncoding(ContentEncoding.of(value));
335   }
336
337   /**

340    * @param value The new <c>Content-Length</c> header value, or <c>-1</c> to unset.
341    * @return This object.
342    */
343   public SELF setContentLength(long value) {
344      return modify(() -> contentLength = value);
345   }
346
347   /**
348    * Sets the content type on this entity bean.
349    *
350    * @param value The new <c>Content-Type</c> header, or <jk>null</jk> to unset.
351    * @return This object.
352    */
353   public SELF setContentType(ContentType value) {
354      return modify(() -> contentType = value);
355   }
356
357   /**
358    * Sets the content type on this entity bean.
359    *
360    * @param value The new <c>Content-Type</c> header, or <jk>null</jk> to unset.
361    * @return This object.
362    */
363   public SELF setContentType(String value) {

365   }

367   /**
368    * Specifies the maximum number of bytes to read or write to and from stream-based resources.
369    *
370    * <p>
371    * Implementation is not universal.
372    *
373    * @param value The new value.  The default is <c>-1</c> which means read everything.
374    * @return This object.
375    */
376   public SELF setMaxLength(int value) {
377      return modify(() -> maxLength = value);
378   }
379
380   /**
381    * Returns an unmodifiable snapshot of this bean.
382    *
383    * <p>
384    * The returned instance is a point-in-time copy of the leaf's nested {@code Unmodifiable} type; any attempt to set a
385    * property on it throws an {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.  This method is idempotent: if this bean is already
386    * unmodifiable it returns itself rather than taking another snapshot.  The receiver is left unchanged (and still
387    * modifiable unless it was already unmodifiable).
388    *
389    * @return An unmodifiable snapshot of this bean, or this bean if it is already unmodifiable.
390    */
391   public abstract SELF unmodifiable();
392
393   @Override /* Overridden from HttpEntity */
394   public void writeTo(OutputStream outStream) throws IOException {
395      // No-op: Intentional empty implementation for optional interface method
396   }
397
398   /**
399    * Compares the shared base content of two entities.
400    *
401    * <p>
402    * This base implementation compares only the fields declared on {@link BasicHttpEntity} and deliberately accepts any
403    * {@code BasicHttpEntity} subtype so that concrete leaves can delegate to it via {@code super.equals(...)}.  It does
404    * <b>not</b> gate on the concrete leaf type; each concrete leaf overrides {@code equals} to first apply an
405    * {@code instanceof <ThatLeaf>} gate (so two unrelated leaves with equal base content are not equal) and then calls
406    * {@code super.equals(...)} to compare the inherited content.  Using {@code instanceof <ThatLeaf>} (rather than
407    * {@code getClass() ==}) is what preserves the immutability invariant that {@code bean.equals(bean.unmodifiable())}
408    * holds, since each {@code X.Unmodifiable} snapshot is a subclass of its leaf {@code X}.
409    */
410   @Override /* Overridden from Object */
411   public boolean equals(Object o) {
412      return o instanceof BasicHttpEntity<?> other && eq(this, other, (x, y) ->
413         eq(x.cached, y.cached) && eq(x.chunked, y.chunked) && eq(x.content, y.content)
414         && eq(x.contentSupplier, y.contentSupplier) && eq(x.contentType, y.contentType)
415         && eq(x.contentEncoding, y.contentEncoding) && eq(x.charset, y.charset)
416         && eq(x.contentLength, y.contentLength) && eq(x.maxLength, y.maxLength));
417   }
418
419   @Override /* Overridden from Object */
420   public int hashCode() {
421      return h(cached, chunked, content, contentSupplier, contentType, contentEncoding, charset, contentLength, maxLength);
422   }
423
424   /**
425    * Same as {@link #asBytes()} but wraps {@link IOException IOExceptions} inside a {@link RuntimeException}.
426    *
427    * @return The contents of this entity as a byte array.
428    */
429   protected byte[] asSafeBytes() {
430      try {
431         return asBytes();
432      } catch (IOException e) {
433         throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
434      }
435   }
436
437   /**
438    * Returns the content of this entity.
439    *
440    * @param <T> The value type.
441    * @param def The default value if <jk>null</jk>.
442    * @return The content object.
443    */
444   @SuppressWarnings({
445      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires cast for content
446   })
447   protected <T> T contentOrElse(T def) {
448      Object o = content;
449      if (o == null && nn(contentSupplier))
450         o = contentSupplier.get();
451      return (o == null ? def : (T)o);
452   }
453
454   /**
455    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if the contents of this entity are provided through an external supplier.
456    *
457    * <p>
458    * Externally supplied content generally means the content length cannot be reliably determined
459    * based on the content.
460    *
461    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the contents of this entity are provided through an external supplier.
462    */
463   protected boolean isSupplied() { return nn(contentSupplier); }
464
465   /**
466    * Returns this object cast to the self type.
467    *
468    * @return This object.
469    */
470   @SuppressWarnings({
471      "unchecked" // CRTP self-type cast is safe: SELF is bound to the concrete leaf type.
472   })
473   protected final SELF self() { return (SELF) this; }
474
475   /**
476    * Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.
477    *
478    * <p>
479    * Every fluent setter routes through this method.  The nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot overrides only this
480    * method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with a single override.
481    *
482    * @param mutation The state change to apply.
483    * @return This object.
484    */
485   protected SELF modify(Runnable mutation) {
486      mutation.run();
487      return self();
488   }
489
490   /**
491    * Deep-freeze hook invoked from the nested {@code Unmodifiable} constructor after the snapshot copy completes.
492    *
493    * <p>
494    * Entities hold no mutable sub-beans (the content-type / content-encoding headers are immutable value objects, and
495    * the content buffer follows the copy-constructor's reference-copy behavior), so this is a documented no-op — the
496    * single throwing {@link #modify(Runnable)} override on the nested {@code Unmodifiable} already freezes the entire
497    * mutation surface.  A leaf that adds its own mutable sub-bean would override this method (calling
498    * {@code super.freeze()} first).
499    */
500   protected void freeze() {
501      // No-op: entities have no mutable sub-beans to deep-freeze.
502   }
503}
